creator: Alexander Terp
description: --layout lists a closed window's tabs but draws none, because how its machines' parts sit side by side is that window's record. Once one process holds every window (MIP-6), that record is in memory and the drawing is possible. Also: windowless --layout JSON has frame: null; exposing the core's place arithmetic for a bare tree would fill it.
title: Draw a closed window's tabs in muster window --layout
